segments.speaker: ANDREW
segments.en: Good morning, Clare House Hotel. Andrew speaking. I’m the Events Manager.

segments.speaker: SAM
segments.en: Good morning, Andrew. My name’s Samantha. I’m arranging a party for my parents’ fiftieth wedding anniversary, and I’m ringing to ask about hiring a room some time next September. Also my parents and several of the guests will need accommodation.

segments.speaker: ANDREW
segments.en: OK, I’m sure we can help you with that. Will you be having a sit-down meal or a buffet?

segments.speaker: SAM
segments.en: Probably a sit-down.

segments.speaker: ANDREW
segments.en: And do you know how many people there’ll be?

segments.speaker: SAM
segments.en: Around eighty, I think.

segments.speaker: ANDREW
segments.en: Well we have two rooms that can hold that number. One is the Adelphi Room. That can seat eighty-five, or hold over a hundred if people are standing for a buffet.

segments.speaker: SAM
segments.en: Right.

segments.speaker: ANDREW
segments.en: If you have live music, there’s room for four or five musicians in the gallery overlooking the room. Our guests usually appreciate the fact that the music can be loud enough for dancing, but not too loud for conversation.

segments.speaker: SAM
segments.en: Yes, I really don’t like it when you can’t talk.

segments.speaker: ANDREW
segments.en: Exactly. Now the Adelphi Room is at the back of the hotel, and there are French windows leading out onto the terrace. This has a beautiful display of pots of roses at that time of the year.

segments.speaker: SAM
segments.en: Which direction does it face?

segments.speaker: ANDREW
segments.en: Southwest, so that side of the hotel gets the sun in the afternoon and early evening.

segments.speaker: SAM
segments.en: Very nice.

segments.speaker: ANDREW
segments.en: From the terrace you can see the area of trees within the grounds of the hotel, or you can stroll through there to the river – that’s on the far side, so it isn’t visible from the hotel.

segments.speaker: SAM
segments.en: OK.

segments.speaker: ANDREW
segments.en: Then another option is the Carlton Room. This is a bit bigger – it can hold up to a hundred and ten people – and it has the advantage of a stage, which is useful if you have any entertainment, or indeed a small band can fit onto it.

segments.speaker: SAM
segments.en: And can you go outside from the room?

segments.speaker: ANDREW
segments.en: No, the Carlton Room is on the first floor, but on one side the windows look out onto the lake.

segments.speaker: SAM
segments.en: Lovely. I think either of those rooms would be suitable.

segments.speaker: ANDREW
segments.en: Can I tell you about some of the options we offer in addition?

segments.speaker: SAM
segments.en: Please do.

segments.speaker: ANDREW
segments.en: As well as a meal, you can have an MC, a Master of Ceremonies, who’ll be with you throughout the party.

segments.speaker: SAM
segments.en: What exactly is the MC’s function? I suppose they make a speech during the meal if we need one, do they?

segments.speaker: ANDREW
segments.en: That’s right. All our MCs are trained as public speakers, so they can easily get people’s attention – many guests are glad to have someone who can make themselves heard above the chatter! And they’re also your support – if anything goes wrong, the MC will deal with it, so you can relax.

segments.speaker: SAM
segments.en: Great! I’ll need to ask you about food, but something else that’s important is accommodation. You obviously have rooms in the hotel, but do you also have any other accommodation, like cabins, for example?

segments.speaker: ANDREW
segments.en: Yes, there are five in the grounds, all self-contained. They each sleep two to four people and have their own living room, bathroom and small kitchen.

segments.speaker: SAM
segments.en: That sounds perfect for what we’ll need. ——————————

segments.speaker: SAM
segments.en: Now you have various facilities, don’t you? Are they all included in the price of hiring the room? The pool, for instance.

segments.speaker: ANDREW
segments.en: Normally you’d be able to use it, but it’ll be closed throughout September for refurbishment, I’m afraid. The gym will be available, though, at no extra charge. That’s open all day, from six in the morning until midnight.

segments.speaker: SAM
segments.en: Right.

segments.speaker: ANDREW
segments.en: And the tennis courts, but there is a small additional payment for those. We have four courts, and it’s worth booking in advance if you possibly can, as there can be quite a long waiting list for them!

segments.speaker: SAM
segments.en: Right. Now could we discuss the food? This would be dinner, around seven o’clock ...
